about.title: About {app}
about.description: Converts PDF documents — datasheets especially — into Markdown, JSON, HTML or plain text.
about.license: Free software under the GNU General Public License v3. It comes with no warranty.
files.drop_hint: Drop PDFs or a folder here — or click to choose
list.degraded: Converted without images (ran out of time)
output.placeholder: Folder next to the source files
output.hint: The folder is remembered and filled in next time. Clear the field and results go next to the source files again.
format.tagged_pdf_tooltip: The original PDF with structure tags added.
format.pdf_tooltip:
A copy of the original PDF with every detected element painted over it:
table cells and their borders, text blocks, headings.
It holds no text — it shows why a table came out wrong.
File name_annotated.pdf; costs next to no time.
images.label: Images:
images.tooltip:
Separate files — PNGs next to the document, linked from the text.
Embed — images inside the .md as Base64: one self-contained
file, but several times larger.
Don't save — text and tables only.
images.hint: Extracting images is the heaviest part of the job: every illustration is rendered again. On ordinary documents you won't notice, but datasheets can have dozens of pages of plots, and those can take minutes.
dpi.label: Resolution:
dpi.tooltip:
Image render resolution. Lower uses less memory and is faster,
but coarser. 144 is the default; 96 is usually enough.
pages.label: Pages:
pages.tooltip:
For example 1,3,5-7. Handy for datasheets: take the description and the
parameter tables, skip dozens of pages of plots.
timeout.label: Timeout per file:
timeout.tooltip:
A file that runs over is retried without images,
and only then marked as failed.
struct.label: Use tags from the PDF
struct.tooltip:
Read the document's built-in structure instead of analysing the layout.
More accurate — but only for PDFs that really have tags.
sanitize.label: Hide sensitive data
reading_order.label: Reading order:
reading_order.tooltip: A fallback for pages where recursive splitting goes wrong.
tables.label: Tables:
tables.tooltip:
Many manufacturers draw tables with incomplete ruling —
the cluster mode puts those together better.
image_format.label: Image format:
threads.label: Threads:
threads.tooltip:
More than one processes pages in parallel (faster,
but the result may differ slightly on some PDFs).
space_ratio.label: Space threshold:
space_ratio.tooltip:
When to insert a space, as a share of the font size. If the gap between
neighbouring characters is wider, a space goes between them.
Lower splits words apart, higher glues them together.
password.label: PDF password:
line_breaks.label: Keep line breaks
header_footer.label: Include headers and footers
strikethrough.label: Mark strikethrough text
hybrid.label: AI mode:
hybrid_url.label: Server address:
hybrid.hint: AI mode needs a separately installed and running server (pip install "opendataloader-pdf[hybrid]", then opendataloader-pdf-hybrid --port 5002). If the server does not answer, the program says so before starting.
